title: CopánQuest
subtitle: Explore the Maya ruins of Copán, Honduras: stelae, temples, macaws and much more.
controls.keys: Move with W A S D or the arrow keys. Shift to run. Space to jump.
controls.mouse: Click the game and move the mouse to look around. Scroll to zoom in or out.
controls.touch: Use the stick on the left to walk and drag on the screen to look around. Push the stick to the edge to run.
controls.settings: Language, sound and credits: in the pause menu (Esc) or the journal (E or the book button).
controls.poi: Walk up to the stelae, altars and temples to learn about them.
credits.intro: CopánQuest uses these sources and tools. Thank you!
debug.title: Debug
jade.all: You found all 10 jade beads! You're a great explorer.
controls.talk: Walk up to people and right-click (or tap the Talk button) to chat. To climb a wooden ladder, walk into the wall.
lens.locked: The time lens unlocks when you reach Archaeologist.
photo.again: You already had this photo; it's updated.
photo.none: Aim at an animal, a person or a monument.
quests.none: Talk to people to get quests.
museum.empty: Dig in the staked squares to find objects.
glyphs.title: Reading Maya numbers
glyphs.hint: A dot is 1, a bar is 5 and the shell is zero.
glyphs.none: You have no unread fragments. Look for more among the ruins!
mouse.hint: Click the game to look around with the mouse · Esc to pause
clock.title: Today in the Maya calendar
clock.tzolkin: Tzolk'in, the 260-day sacred calendar: a number from 1 to 13 and one of 20 day names.
clock.haab: Haab', the 365-day solar year: 18 months of 20 days plus 5 extra days (Wayeb').
clock.long: Long Count: days counted from the start of the Maya era, in 3114 BC.
tut.move.title: Walk
tut.move.keys: Use W A S D or the arrow keys to walk. Shift to run, Space to jump. Walk toward the entrance.
tut.move.touch: Use the joystick on the left to walk; push it to the edge to run. The Jump button jumps. Walk toward the entrance.
tut.look.title: Look around
tut.look.keys: Click the game and move the mouse to look. The wheel zooms the camera in and out.
tut.look.touch: Drag your finger on the screen to look around.
tut.camera.title: Explorer's camera
tut.camera.keys: Press C to take out the camera. Left click or F takes the photo. Press C again to put it away.
tut.camera.touch: Tap the camera button (on the right) to take it out and the big button to take the photo. Close it with ✕.
tut.journal.title: Your journal
tut.journal.keys: Press E to open your journal (inventory): quests, album, museum and rank. Close it with E or Esc.
tut.journal.touch: Tap the book to open your journal (inventory): quests, album, museum and rank. Close it with ✕.
tut.pause.title: Pause menu
tut.pause.keys: Press Esc (or the Menu button) to pause. Language, sound and controls are there. Press Esc to continue.
tut.pause.touch: Tap ☰ Menu to pause. Language, sound and controls are there. Tap Resume to continue.
tut.talk.title: Talk to people
tut.talk.keys: Walk up to Don Mateo, the guide, just past the entrance, and right-click to talk. Right-click also observes animals, digs and hits the ball.
tut.talk.touch: Walk up to Don Mateo, the guide, just past the entrance, and tap Talk. The same button observes animals, digs and hits the ball.
tut.done.title: All set, go explore!
tut.done.keys: Look for the golden diamonds (places to learn about) and the floating trowels (dig sites). Welcome to Copán!
tut.done.touch: Look for the golden diamonds (places to learn about) and the floating trowels (dig sites). Welcome to Copán!
sound.title: Sound
controls.more: Right-click: talk, observe, dig or hit the ball · E: journal · M: map · C: camera · T: time lens · R: back to the entrance · Esc: pause
record.kicker: Now playing on the record player
record.kind: Fantasia for violin, cello and harp
record.trio: Venetian Trio: Howard Rattay (violin), Rosario Bourdon (cello) and Francis J. Lapitino (harp)
record.rights: Public domain. Digitized by the U.S. Library of Congress (National Jukebox).
install.why: Install CopánQuest on your phone: it opens from its own icon, full screen, like any other app.
install.ios1: Tap Safari's Share button (the square with the arrow pointing up).
install.ios2: Scroll down and choose “Add to Home Screen”.
install.ios3: Tap “Add”. CopánQuest will appear with your apps.
install.and1: Open the browser menu (the three dots ⋮).
install.and2: Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
install.and3: Confirm. CopánQuest will appear with your apps.
buggy.locked: Tomás's buggy won't start: talk to him
buggy.unlocked: Tomás fixed his buggy! You can drive it now
buggy.keys: W/S gas and brake · A/D steer · Space drift · Shift turbo
buggy.broken: The buggy won't start: find Tomás's toolbox
